title: Add protocol v2 fixture skeleton
summary: Protocol v1 replay exists, but the repository needs a v2 fixture skeleton before the first breaking schema change so compatibility expectations are captured before implementation pressure.
expectedFailureModes: A breaking response shape lands without a v2 fixture proving the migration boundary.
V2 placeholder fixtures pass while still being parsed as v1 metadata.
Docs describe protocol migration policy but tests cannot detect missing v2 evidence.
nextAction: When protocol v2 is intentionally designed, add concrete tests/fixtures/v2/*.v2.json files and docs/protocol-migrations/v2.md in the same bump.
